title: VeteranHODL: Hunting Time

prize.note: funded in two tranches, 210000 sats on 2023-07-22 and 210000 sats on 2026-07-31, the day before the author's wallet-type announcement post

target_format: 12-word phrase, one word per clue image in publication order; author states an Electrum wallet

derivation.summary: one clue image equals one word, in the order the author posted them; derive BIP39/BIP84 or an Electrum segwit seed and compare to the escrow address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vector for the BIP39/BIP84 branch; the Electrum segwit branch (the format the author actually named) has no certified vector

difficulty_note: the mechanism is understood and a candidate word pool exists for all 12 positions; the combinatorial sweep of that pool is only about 20 percent run and was not compared against the target address, and the wallet format the author named (Electrum) has no certified oracle yet

leads.title: re-run the numeric-index hypothesis after cleaning the candidate pools

third_party_material: the novel is not reproduced; the clue images are the author's own puzzle photographs posted on X and are described but not included in this folder
